description:
Delete the superseded code surface after all consumers are migrated: `BchCode::new(n, k, t, field)`, the redundant-parameter `from_generator` form, the private polynomial LCM, `ExtendedBchCode`, the unconditional matrix cache, and parallel BCH-specific abstractions.

- [hard] REQ-02: The workspace builds and passes with clippy warnings denied and formatting clean.
title: Delete the superseded BCH code surface
